profile.headline: ☁️ Cloud Enthusiast | Advocate for the advancement of AI Technologies | Google/Oracle Certified ⚙️ Operations/Infra Guru | Automation Advocate | 👨‍💻 Technologist
profile.summary:
A Software/Reliability Engineer with 8+ years experience as a Technology Lead. Experiences also include serving as Lead System Engineer, Customer Liason and Architect. A realist problem solver gathering pertinent facts, anticipating issues, and developing new systems to optimize operations, address problems, and improve overall efficiency. 

Areas of interest for Automation: 
◼️ Cloud Technologies
◼️ IaC
◼️ Bash/Ksh scripting
◼️ Perl
◼️ Python
◼️ Front-end using Javascript/Jquery
◼️ HTML5/CSS

Keen on learning more of: 
◼️ Cloud Computing
◼️ Terraform
◼️ Ansible
◼️ Go
◼️ Ruby/Ruby on Rails
◼️ The 'Sec' in DevSecOPS 

Through a forward-thinking perspective, I can see the big picture to inspire my team members to achieve specific objectives. I have exceeded standards of all my positions and encouraged my peers to emulate my performance. Through my sound judgment and critical decision making, I’ve been able to complete projects and elude errors and risks.  

To learn more about me, please review the rest of my profile. If you wish to connect with me, please send a personal note with your connection request. 

I look forward to engaging with you.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.insights: Incident Management, Business Strategy and +20 skills

positions.title: Lead System Engineer
positions.description:
Architect, design and support Continuous Integration and Delivery pipeline. Head launch of releases to production and performance environments using DevOps methodologies/tools (Jenkins, Git, and Chef). Serve as Team Automation Expert to develop scripts supporting automation of numerous tasks and reports saving labor/time. Apply various system tools to monitor and address production stability incidents across macys.com and bloomingdales.com, including infrastructural components in multi-tiered environments. Mentor and collaborate with offshore team to champion duties during offshore hours. 

DELIVERING IMPACT
✔️ Led efforts from Operations team for Digital Transformation POC to move OnPrem application suite/stack to Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
✔️ PCI Key Custodian rotating encryption/decryption keys in production during the renewal process (only two people possess responsibility companywide). 
✔️ Championed key project to add a new data center for macy.com and bloomingdales.com, which was coordinated across multiple DevOps teams. 
✔️ Fueled continuous quality improvement by engineering scripts to observe production application versions that seize mismatch and enable execution of solutions before issues become apparent; eluded broad impact, saved multiple labor hours, and enhanced efficiency of team accountabilities. 
✔️ Fixed security loophole by devising front-end GUI through Javascript/HTML/CSS to enable users to observe production configuration and evaluate across various microservices/applications to support troubleshooting without need to login to production systems.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Administered Mediation Zone as well as the platform for Verizon Wireless Enterprise Rating. Focused daily on delivering production support for critical open systems applications running on UNIX, Linux, and VMware as well as oversaw ratings of millions of data/voice records per day for the largest wireless career in the country. Main contact person for management to deliver swift reports for the database.

DELIVERING IMPACT
✔️ Requested to compose PL/SQL procedures and Python scripts to swiftly produce reports scanning vast amounts of data in the Oracle Backend database or within intricate Linux VMs.

positions.title: Technology Team Lead
positions.description:
From 2009 to 2014:
Managed 2 SMEs onshore and 1 offshore while providing on-call support to offshore 24/7; I issued 24/7 support for normal/emergency deployments of new releases to production environments. 

DELIVERING IMPACT
✔️ 1 of 2 experts out of 20 candidates chosen to travel to Israel for product (CRM launch) training. 
✔️ Received praise for beating deadline by six months by relocating to Atlanta, GA to create a new Production Deployment Team from scratch. 
✔️ Formulated a new team with innovative processes and implementation documents to change the legacy deployment system; authored code/tool to replace a legacy system from scratch, which remained an active day. 
✔️ Applied Javascript, HTML, Ksh, and SQL to develop SLA dashboard GUI to present daily SLA statistics of all areas supported by the company for direct presentation to executives. 


From 2014 to 2015:
Governed 12 experts onshore and 5 offshore while serving as Tech Lead to engage with customer’s (T-Mobile) Performance Engineering Team and configured applications/microservices. I was the point person ensuring the availability of end-to-end environments for customers and delivered on-call support to offshore 24/7. I performed the annual reviews and approved timesheets for SMEs within the operational team. 

DELIVERING IMPACT
✔️ Gained special recognition in 2014 from upper management for exemplary initiatives in tandem with a customer in provisioning special projects such as migration of environment from Unix to Linux-based OS systems. 
✔️ Attained another special acknowledgment from offshore management for outstanding support during offshore hours by being on call for the team and logging in to provide help when needed. 
✔️ Successful track record of efficient on- and offshore resource management.

positions.title: IT Expert
positions.description:
Architected, planned, designed, tested, and maintained the in-house company products. Helped the R&D Team facilitate the billing platform for Sprint/Nextel as well as automate daily jobs to support end-to-end batch operations. Diagnosed all areas of ENABLER and ENSEMBLE InHouse applications in production and non-productions environments. Attended the Change Approval Board (CAB) Committee to inspect daily change requests by all teams. 

DELIVERING IMPACT
✔️ Recognized by Senior Directors of Operations for exceptional contribution to the project that championed MetroPCS billing systems. 
✔️ Earned Certificate of Weblogic Administration and received the Certificate of Outstanding Contribution for 1st Production Release Implementation post-Sprint/Nextel merger.  
✔️ Enhanced professionalism by learning new tools to streamline company processes and participate in the advancement of other team members to augment team camaraderie. 
✔️ Partaken in a special team that worked at the client’s site to establish “Conversion” of 1.1M customers and merge them into existing client infrastructure.
✔️ Participated in special teams of one expert from multiple facets to champion environment buildout for Sprint/Nextel merger.
